charts.title: TOI-3235 b: orbits around TOI-3235
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-3235's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-3235 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Hobson et al. 2023 (2023ApJ...946L...4H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HOBSON_ET_AL_2023): P 2.59261842 d

charts.title: TOI-3235 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-3235 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (64, 101, 102) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 243641947, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 6-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 6-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
